title: Login required and least privilege
steps: Connect as the app; try to drop a collection and create a user; connect with no login and with a wrong password
query: connectionStatus; drop(); createUser; find() without auth
expected: App = lpa_nosql_app (SCRAM) with find/insert/update/remove only; drop + createUser refused; no-login and wrong password refused
actual: lpa_nosql_app@lpa_nosql; actions changeStream, collStats, find, insert, listCollections, listIndexes, remove, update; drop -> Unauthorized; createUser -> Unauthorized; no login -> Unauthorized; wrong password -> AuthenticationFailed

title: Encryption in transit (TLS)
steps: Connect with TLS (the app) and without TLS
expected: TLS connection works; plain-text connection refused
actual: TLS ok = true; without TLS -> MongoServerSelectionError

title: Personal data encrypted; session tokens hashed
steps: Read the stored login event and session straight from MongoDB
expected: IP stored only encrypted and decrypts with the key; a changed ciphertext is rejected; the cookie token is not stored
actual: stored "v1.dJUIY5v8YQOGNZ9S.Qu..." -> "127.0.0.1"; plain IP in doc = false; tampered -> Unsupported state or unable to authentic; session found by hash = true; raw token stored = false

title: Data types enforced by the database
steps: Insert reviews straight into MongoDB with rating 7, rating "5" (text) and no dates

title: Indexes built (incl. TTL, unique, text)
steps: List the indexes of each collection
expected: TTL on sessions.expiresAt (0 s) and activity_log.at (365 days); unique one review per client; text index
actual: sessions: _id_, ttl_expiresAt, by_user | activity_log: _id_, ttl_at, type_at, user_at | product_reviews: _id_, one_review_per_client, sku_status_newest, status_rating, text_search; TTL 0s / 365 days

title: Queries are answered from indexes
steps: explain() the product-page, activity-filter and text-search queries; compare with an un-indexed regex
expected: IXSCAN / TEXT on the right index (no COLLSCAN); the regex query needs a COLLSCAN
actual: reviews FETCH>IXSCAN (sku_status_newest); activity FETCH>IXSCAN (type_at); text TEXT; regex COLLSCAN

title: Insert many + read/write throughput
steps: insertMany 1000 activity events (unordered), read them back by index, deleteMany
actual: 1000 inserted in 57 ms (17544 writes/s); 1000 read in 36 ms (27778 reads/s); 1000 deleted

title: Insert one review from the web page
steps: Customer reviews a dock she never bought; then buys the webcam and reviews it (tags repeated, mixed case)
expected: First refused (400); review saved with verified=true, tags cleaned to a unique list; product rating updated
actual: not bought -> 400; order 302 -> /orders/INV-1007?placed=1; review -> 302; doc: 3 stars, tags [video quality, microphone], verified true, author Alex Turner; rating 5 (1) -> 4 (2)

title: One review per customer per product
steps: Post a second review of the webcam; insert a copy straight into MongoDB
expected: Web: refused with "already reviewed"; database: duplicate key error 11000

title: Find one, find many, text search, filter by index
steps: Open the webcam page (JSON); staff search reviews for "noise"; filter 2 stars or less; shop list with ratings
expected: Webcam page has its reviews + summary; text search finds the reviews that mention noise; filter finds the 2-star review; shop shows ratings
actual: webcam: 2 reviews, avg 4; "noise": LPA-006, LPA-005; <=2 stars: LPA-008 2; shop items with rating: 5/7

title: Update: edit a review; helpful votes counted once
steps: Customer edits her review (3 -> 4 stars); staff clicks Helpful twice at the same moment, admin once; customer votes on her own review
expected: Edit saved with a new updatedAt; helpful = 2 (one per person); own vote refused
actual: 302; rating 3 -> 4; updatedAt changed = true; votes 200/409/200; own 409; helpful = 2 (U-001, U-002)

title: Change-stream trigger reacts to database changes
steps: Insert a 1-star review straight into MongoDB (no app code involved)
expected: Within seconds: product_ratings for LPA-008 rebuilt and a REVIEW_ALERT logged; resume token saved
actual: rating 3.67 (3) -> 3 (4) in 108 ms; alert = "REVIEW_ALERT 1-star review of LPA-008 by Logi..."; resume token saved = true

title: Delete: authors delete only their own review
steps: Customer tries to delete another client's review; then deletes her own
expected: Other review: 404 (kept); own review removed; webcam rating rebuilt without it
actual: other -> 404; own -> 302; still in DB = 0; webcam 4.5 (2) -> 5 (1)

title: Moderation and page permissions
steps: Staff hides a review; customer opens Reviews moderation and the Activity log; staff opens the Activity log
expected: Hidden review disappears from the shop; customer and staff blocked from pages that are not theirs (403)
actual: hide 302; still visible to customers = false; customer /reviews 403; staff /activity 403; customer /activity 403

title: Sessions stored in MongoDB
steps: Add to cart, then open the cart on a NEW app process; sign out; deactivate the user
expected: Cart still there after the restart; logout deletes that session; deactivation deletes all of the user's sessions
actual: cart after restart 200, numpad kept = true; sessions 2 -> logout 1 -> deactivate 0

title: TTL index removes expired sessions
steps: Store a session that expired a minute ago; use its cookie; wait for the TTL monitor
expected: Expired cookie refused at once (redirect to login); MongoDB deletes the document by itself (TTL monitor runs every 60 s)

title: Clear message when MongoDB is not available
steps: Start the app with a wrong MongoDB password; try to sign in
expected: Console warning; 503 "database is not available"; no technical details
actual: warning = true; status 503; message = true; leaks = false
